title: Scalar-parameter array lift: ten reopened formulas re-evaluated, 10/10 typed bit matches
upstream_status_verbatim: The array-admission class this stream tracks is resolved on the current baseline.
status_plain: Ten representative reopened scalar-parameter array-lift formulas were re-evaluated in live Excel 16.0 build 20026 (workbook compatibility 2) and compared against the OxFunc surface output under exact typed equality with no tolerance allowed, scoring 10 of 10 typed matches and 0 mismatches. The source publishes ONE figure over the ten formulas. Its own table names two ADDRESS rows, two SWITCH rows, two IFS rows, one COMPLEX row, one BINOMDIST row, one NORMDIST row and one DOLLARFR row; this record does not compose per-surface fractions from that table, because the source publishes none. The stream names a second build: its Ref notes say the W090 successor tranches used build 19929, so the record is genuinely two-builds-named and the 20026 belongs to the sign-off specifically. Neither the sign-off nor the Ref notes names a host CPU or an architecture.
